key_visual_point: The new Teams plan grew from zero to 15,000 seats in two months, passing Enterprise
script:
The bar chart displays paid seats by plan from January to March 2025.
Pro seats started at 41,000 in January, increased to 43,000 in February, and reached 44,000 in March.
The Enterprise plan began with 2,000 seats in January, remained at 2,000 in February, and grew to 3,000 in March.
The Teams plan, launched in February, shows zero seats in January, then jumped to 6,000 seats in February and 15,000 seats in March.
This rapid growth made the Teams plan the second-largest plan by March.
Enterprise pilots are currently running in four regions.

key_visual_point: Active editors climbed about 40% in the six weeks after the week 7 release
script: This chart shows weekly active presentation editors. After staying flat near 2.1 million for the first six weeks, the number steadily climbed to 2.9 million by week 12. This represents weekly active editors for Q1.

key_visual_point: Sales jumped about 50% when the catering menu launched in December and stayed at that higher level
script: Sales jumped about 50% in December and stayed high through February. This bar chart shows monthly sales in USD from September 2024 to February 2025. Key details include the catering menu launch on December 2nd, the same two staff, and no paid advertising.

key_visual_point: The new Teams plan grew from zero to 15,000 seats in two months, passing Enterprise
script: The bar chart shows paid seats by plan from January to March 2025. The Teams plan grew from zero seats to 15,000, becoming the second-largest plan. Pro seats increased across the quarter. The Teams plan launched in February, and Enterprise pilots are in four regions.

key_visual_point: Active editors climbed about 40% in the six weeks after the week 7 release
script: The line chart shows weekly active presentation editors for the first 12 weeks of 2025. The number of active editors stayed flat at around 2.1 million for the first six weeks. Then, it steadily climbed to 2.9 million by week 12. A marker at week seven indicates the release of 'Magic Write for slides.' This metric counts anyone who edits a presentation at least once a week, with mobile editors included from week three onward.

key_visual_point: Sales jumped about 50% when the catering menu launched in December and stayed at that higher level
script: This bar chart shows monthly sales in USD from September 2024 to February 2025. Sales jumped about 50% in December to $27.4k and remained at a higher level in January and February, reaching $30.3k by February. The slide title is "Monthly sales since September." Key points include the catering menu launch on December 2nd, with the same two staff and no paid advertising.
